topic: Capricor deramiocel CRL in DMD cardiomyopathy
scope: Historical regulatory precedent analysis; not limited to last 7 days.
screenshot_method: Webpages captured in Chrome; FDA CRL PDF pages rendered from the source PDF into browser-view evidence pages and captured in Chrome.

sources.label: FDA CRL, clinical efficacy deficiency
sources.caption: FDA CRL page 1: HOPE-2 failed prespecified endpoints; cardiomyopathy case relied on post hoc analyses.

sources.label: FDA CRL, multiplicity and randomized-control recommendation
sources.caption: FDA CRL page 2: 50 exploratory endpoints, no multiplicity strategy, and OLE confounding.

sources.label: Capricor July 2025 CRL announcement
sources.caption: Capricor announcement: CRL, substantial-evidence issue, additional clinical data, and HOPE-2/OLE/natural-history support.

sources.label: Capricor September 2025 Type A meeting update
sources.caption: Capricor Type A update: FDA aligned that HOPE-3 could serve as the additional study and define endpoints.

sources.label: FDA Multiple Endpoints guidance
sources.caption: FDA guidance: multiple endpoints increase false-conclusion risk without multiplicity adjustment.

sources.label: FDA NurOwn ALS update
sources.caption: FDA NurOwn update: none of the randomized primary or secondary endpoints were met.

sources.label: BioMarin Kyndrisa DMD CRL
sources.caption: BioMarin DMD precedent: FDA issued a CRL and concluded substantial evidence had not been met.
